title: Maid, wife and widow in one day.
html_source: ‘Lord Talbot of Malahide’ leads Father Conmee to think of another thread in the Talbot story: “The story is about Mr. Hussey, the son of Lord galtrim, and his bethothed,Maud, the daughter of Lord Plunkett. The bridgroom was called from the altar to lead his troops against a marauding party and was killed; thus his bride was'maid, wife and widow in one day” (Gifford & Seidman. Ulysses Annotated, p263).
